nl: Remove the unused import from tools/paths.py. The other imports are used and stay.
reference_bash:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import os, pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('tools/paths.py'); t = p.read_bytes().decode()
assert t.count('import glob\n') == 1, 'tools/paths.py'
p.write_bytes(t.replace('import glob\n', '').encode())
EOF
reference_pwsh:
$p = Join-Path $PWD 'tools/paths.py'; $t = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($p)
$o = 'import glob
'; $n = ''
if (([regex]::Matches($t, [regex]::Escape($o))).Count -ne 1) { throw 'unexpected match count in tools/paths.py' }
[IO.File]::WriteAllText($p, $t.Replace($o, $n))
